exposure: Desire for the experience of a vaginal birth
Prior reason for a caesarean section
outcome: Choice of vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC)
cohort: The study included 173 pregnant women who had previously had only one caesarean birth.
finding: Desire for the experience of a vaginal birth strongly predicted the choice of VBAC, but this relationship was moderated by a high powerful others locus of control.
mod_finding: Desire for a vaginal birth experience strongly predicted choice of VBAC, though this was dampened among women with a high locus of control regarding powerful others.
